variables.description: The port on the host to access the Microbin web interface.
variables.label: Microbin Web Port

variables.description: The base URL for the Microbin instance (e.g., https://paste.example.com). Leave empty for relative paths.
variables.label: Microbin Base URL

variables.description: The password for the Microbin administration interface. Leave empty for no admin password.
variables.label: Microbin Admin Password

variables.description: Maximum content length for a paste in kilobytes.
variables.label: Max Content Length (KB)

variables.description: Default expiration time for pastes in seconds. 0 means no expiration.
variables.label: Default Expiration (Seconds)

variables.description: A random salt string for secure hashes. It is HIGHLY RECOMMENDED to change this from the default value.
variables.label: Microbin Salt
